import logging
import pytest
from kind_a_kit import LIVE_RULES, TERM_ANSWER, TERM_QUESTION, TICK, let_jobs_decline, mark, plan, said_to_the_room
from test_h3_tempo import call      # noqa: F401
import pytest as _p
pytestmark = _p.mark.usefixtures('no_lead')

class H(logging.Handler):
    def __init__(s): super().__init__(level=1); s.l=[]
    def emit(s, r):
        m=r.getMessage()
        
        if any(k in m for k in ('decision kind','judge tid','why kind=act','resolution','lookup')): s.l.append(m.replace('echo-sync ','')[:150])

@pytest.mark.parametrize('said', ['Нет, ты не прав, всё было по-другому, я там был.','А вы во сколько завтра выезжаете?','Короче, мы потом пошли в кино.'])
def test_dbg(call, said):
    h=H(); lg=logging.getLogger(); lg.addHandler(h); lg.setLevel(1)
    rig = call(**LIVE_RULES)
    plan(rig, asked=TERM_QUESTION, answer=TERM_ANSWER)
    before = mark(rig); n0=len(h.l)
    said_to_the_room(rig, 'r1', said)
    rig.pump(TICK)
    let_jobs_decline(rig, before['runs'])
    rig.pump(6.0)
    a=rig.w.snapshot()
    lg.removeHandler(h)
    assert False, 'REV %s->%s | '%(before['revision'],a['revision'])+' || '.join(h.l[n0:])
